name: tip-selector
title: Tip Selector
description: A checkout tip picker set on a draggable tape with preset chips, a Round up shortcut and rolling totals.

props.name: subtotal
props.description: The order amount before the tip.

props.name: percents
props.description: Percents marked on the tape and offered as shortcuts.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Where the tape starts when uncontrolled, in percent.

props.name: max
props.description: The far end of the tape, in percent.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the tip changes, with the tip amount and the percent.

props.name: onPay
props.description: Called with the total when the order button is pressed.
